metadata.description: Agent plugins that carry coding conventions.

plugins.name: python-rules
plugins.description: General Python conventions and patterns — typing, configuration, command-line interfaces, error handling, services, dependency injection, testing, file organization, comments. Framework-independent. Loaded only when Python code is touched.

plugins.name: logging-rules
plugins.description: Logging conventions — event-name messages, structured context, error and level usage at call sites, plus centralized configuration. Framework-independent. Loaded only when logging code is touched.

plugins.name: lint-rules
plugins.description: The house lint standard — which checks a repository runs, derived from its own signals; one tool per concern; canonical hook entries carrying no version numbers, and the procedure that supplies them; how a local hook finds its tool; and when a whole repository is brought into line. Load when writing or changing a lint configuration, or when asked to converge a repository's quality gates.

plugins.name: clickhouse-rules
plugins.description: ClickHouse conventions — reading merge-time-deduplicated tables without FINAL (argMax / LIMIT 1 BY in SQL), write-once facts and cheap version columns; joins with a small filtered right side, dictionaries for lookups, denormalization at write time. Loaded only when ClickHouse queries or table DDL are touched.

plugins.name: django-rules
plugins.description: Rules and patterns for Django code — models, django-ninja APIs, admin, settings, app layout and tests. Loaded only when Django code is touched.

plugins.name: just-rules
plugins.description: Justfile conventions — reuse of shared modules, the module preamble, recipe attributes and bodies, argument fidelity and recipe-to-recipe calls, and per-project entrypoint files. Loaded only when a justfile is touched.

plugins.name: metabase-rules
plugins.description: Rules for working with Metabase — MBQL-first query authoring, personal-collection placement, and dashboards and questions kept as code with Terraform. Loaded when creating or updating Metabase entities, by any mechanism, or handling Metabase content kept as code.

plugins.name: redis-rules
plugins.description: Redis usage patterns — distributed locking with redis-py's Lock (acquire/release, TTL, key naming, worker-task contention). Loaded only when Redis coordination code is touched.

plugins.name: plugin-rules
plugins.description: Agent plugin authoring conventions — one canonical copy of each rule in tool-neutral prose, a thin router skill per domain, brief rule files with `paths:` frontmatter, the two portable manifests, exec-form hooks, and parsing every manifest before commit. Load when writing or changing a plugin's skill, rule files, manifests or hooks.
